aiChatDefaultModel.description: Sets which model is already selected when the AI Chat panel first opens, using the model's `modelName` (not its displayName). aiChatMaxFiles.description: The maximum number of files that can be attached to a conversation at the same time. Trying to add one more past the limit, shows a "too many files" chip instead of attaching the file.

aiChatModels.description: Lists the models a user can pick from in the AI Chat panel's model dropdown. `modelName` is what gets sent to your backend, while `displayName` is the friendlier label shown on screen (it falls back to `modelName` if you skip it). aiChatPanelMaxWidth.description: The maximum width, in pixels, the panel can be resized to. Leaving it at null falls back to Froala's built-in limit of 640px.

aiChatPanelWidth.description: Sets how wide, in pixels, the AI Chat panel is when it first opens. Froala doesn't remember a resized width on its own, so listen for the `aiAssist.chatPanelResized` event, save the value yourself, and pass it back in here the next time you initialize the editor.

aiChatReasoningEnabled.description: Sets whether the reasoning toggle in the AI Chat panel starts on or off when the panel opens. As of V5.5.0, if the model currently selected in aiChatModels explicitly declares reasoning: false, the toggle is forced off, rendered disabled, and can't be turned on regardless of this option value.

aiChatRequestTimeoutMs.description: Sets how long, in milliseconds, Froala will wait for an AI Chat response before giving up and showing an error. The default is 60 seconds. Pass 0 or null to turn the timeout off entirely and wait indefinitely.

aiChatStreamResponse.description: Whether AI Chat requests use streaming (`requestAnswerStream`) or a single buffered response (`requestAnswer`).

aiChatSupportedFileTypes.description: Lists which file extensions a user is allowed to attach through the "Upload File" context source. aiChatWebSearchEnabled.description: Sets whether the web-search toggle in the AI Chat panel starts on or off when a user opens the panel. As of V5.5.0, if the model currently selected in aiChatModels explicitly declares webSearch: false, the toggle is forced off, rendered disabled, and can't be turned on regardless of this option value.

aiChatWelcomeMessage.description: Replaces the intro sentence shown in the AI Chat panel's empty state before anyone has typed anything, in place of Froala's default writing-assistant greeting. selectionActionButtons.description: Controls which buttons show up in the small popup that appears whenever a user selects text in the editor. shortcutsHint.description: When enabled, the shortcut is displayed in the button tooltip.

showChangesEnabled.description: If set to true, track changes will be active by default.

showFindAndReplace.description: If set to true, the Find and Replace popup will be displayed automatically when the editor is initialized.

toolbarButtonsEnabledOnEditorOff.description: When `edit.off()` is called, the toolbar is disabled and all buttons become non-clickable by default.

toolbarButtonsMD.description: The list of buttons that appear in the rich text editor’s toolbar on medium devices (≥ 992px). By default on MD screens, the editor uses the same buttons as for [toolbarButtons](#toolbarButtons "toolbarButtons option").

toolbarButtonsXS.description: The list of buttons that appear in the rich text editor’s toolbar on extra small devices (< 768px).

toolbarContainer.description: A custom HTML selector placing the toolbar inside.

toolbarStickyOffset.description: The offset of the sticky toolbar from top of the page. If [toolbarBottom](#toolbarBottom "toolbarBottom") option is used, then this option will define the offset of the toolbar from the bottom of the page.

toolbarVisibleWithoutSelection.description: Keeps the editor visible next to the cursor even when there is no selection. **Note:** This option is available only when the [toolbarInline](#toolbarInline "toolbarInline") option is set to `true`.

tooltips.description: Control if tooltips are shown when getting with mouse over the buttons from the toolbar.

trackChangesEnabled.description: If set to true, show changes feature will be active by default.

typingTimer.description: Time in milliseconds to define how long the typing pause may be without the change to be saved in the undo stack. The minimum value that can be set is 500.

useClasses.description: When this options is disabled the edited content will have the external CSS properties converted to inline style. **Note:** For this option to work correctly, it is necessary to load the CSS files from the same domain the editor is running on.

videoInsertButtons.description: The buttons that appear in the insert video popup, when a video is inserted into the WYSIWYG editor.

videoMaxSize.description: The maximum video size allowed on upload in bytes. The default value is 30MB. Although this makes an additional check before uploading the video, it is highly recommended to check image size on your server too.

videoMove.description: Allows changing the position of the videos by dragging them.

videoResize.description: Enable or disable resizing the videos inside the editor.

videoResponsive.description: Enable or disable inserting responsive videos in the Froala Editor.

videoSizeButtons.description: The buttons that appear in the edit video size popup, when changing the size of a selected video.

videoSplitHTML.description: Enables splitting the HTML when inserting a new view.

videoTextNear.description: Allows text near a video when it is aligned to the left or to the right. Disabling this option will make the `display` button for image editor popup unavailable.

videoUploadMethod.description: The HTTP video upload request type.

wordAllowedStyleProps.description: The list of allowed CSS attributes to be used for tags when pasting from Word.

wordCounterCount.description: Enables or disables the display of the word counter.

wordDeniedTags.description: Tags that are removed together with their content when pasting something into the rich text editor from Word.

wordPasteKeepFormatting.description: Choose the default action when `wordPasteModal` option is enabled.

events.description: Fires whenever a single change, called a hunk, in the active review session is individually accepted or rejected. This is an informational event and cannot be canceled.

events.name: aiAssist.reviewEnded
events.description: Fires when a standalone review session ends because every change in it has been resolved, either accepted or rejected.

events.name: aiAssist.reviewStarted
events.description: Fires when a standalone review session opens, right after the AI response has been diffed against the original selection and shown inline for review.

methods.description: Sends a single buffered request to the configured AI backend and resolves with `{ answer, session_id?, webSearchUsed? }`. The result is a snapshot rather than a live view, so mutating it has no effect on the panel, and an empty array is returned when there are no messages yet.
